settings.verdictRule: calibrated on a cell: at least three independent datasets each within the calibrated band (0.8 <= delta <= 1.25, sigmaM <= 0.35) with none of their runs stopped, and the pooled pairs within that band too; indicative: pooled within 0.67 <= delta <= 1.5, sigmaM <= 0.5; otherwise not calibrated
settings.claimRule: claim protocol 2026-11-12, section 4: calibrated if in the calibrated band in >= 3 datasets and outside the indicative band in none; indicative if in the indicative band (or better) in >= 2; else not calibrated; a dataset with a stopped run counts as outside
